methodology.geographicSourceOfTruth: The deployed Malaysia ADM1 GeoJSON remains authoritative. Other geometries are used only to flag missingGeometrySuspected for manual review.
methodology.originalState: Parsed from the station address because charging_stations has no separate state column.
methodology.outsideMalaysiaInterpretation: Outside every deployed Malaysian ADM1 land polygon; this is not an assessment of maritime territory.
methodology.missingGeometryRule: Outside deployed and full-resolution geoBoundaries, but inside at least one independent ADM1 reference.
methodology.syntheticDemoFlag: Conservative flag for a repeated generic street-address template; evidence for review, not proof that a record is synthetic.
